note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Congress's copies. The Ley de Movilidad del Estado de Nayarit (last amendment published 20 Jul 2026) names the Secretaría de Movilidad del Estado de Nayarit as the Secretaría (art. 5, XXXI), gives the licences it issues up to three years (art. 161), classes the automovilista licence (art. 162), and asks every applicant to be over eighteen (art. 163, I); a person over sixteen and under eighteen may have a provisional licence of at most a year (arts. 168-169), not held. The Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Nayarit for 2026 (Periódico Oficial, 29 Dec 2025), art. 34, charges an automovilista licence valid three years 8.5 UMA (the minor's provisional licence 9.9). The fee is held in UMA, worth the UMA's value on the day it's paid, rounded to the centavo as the game rounds every amount (no source read says how the state rounds it; until 2026-10-30, when the form took a fee in an index unit, it stood null). The three-year term is held.
